review_candidates.title: Data Center Analyst
review_candidates.description: Why You Belong Here At Victoria’s Secret & Co, you’ll join a world-leading specialty retail brand recognized globally for innovation and excellence in lingerie and fashion. You’ll work alongside industry leaders to set the standard for what a retail brand can achieve, placing customers at the center of everything we do to create products and experiences that bring them joy. We believe everyone deserves a place where they truly belong. We celebrate individuality and know that your passion, experience, and unique perspective strengthen our team and business. Here, you’ll be empowered to perform, grow, and engage through unmatched opportunities to develop your skills, gain real-world experience, and learn from the best in the business. Description Data Center Analyst - IT Operations Objective: End-to-End Data Center Infrastructure Management & Operational Excellence Gain and maintain deep expertise across all corporate data centers (DC4, DC5, DC6), including power systems (UPS, generators, batteries), HVAC/CRAC systems, fire suppression and detection mechanisms, network/MDF/IDF layouts, structured cabling, and access controls. Lead preventive maintenance, availability risk assessments, and modernization initiatives ensuring Tier level compliance and 99.99% operational uptime. Own execution and continuous improvement of data center health scorecards, facility audits, redundancy validations, capacity management, and sustainability practices. Manage vendor engagement lifecycle — scope definition, work permit approvals, supervision of maintenance works, validation of deliverables, and service performance reviews. Function as onsite Incident Commander during emergencies (power, cooling, network, environmental issues) ensuring swift mitigation and minimal business impact Objective: Batch Operations and Workflow Reliability Continuously monitor job executions via Control-M Enterprise Manager. Promptly investigate and respond to job failures. Perform job holds, reruns, kills, and loads as required. Coordinate with OS, network, and Security teams as needed. Document incidents and escalate per the escalation matrix. Monitor Control-M infrastructure for high availability, performance, and scalability. Troubleshoot basic job execution issues, dependencies, and resource allocation. Maintain accurate logs of all operations and incidents for audit and handover. Objective: Monitoring Strategy, Physical Security & Compliance Governance Use advanced monitoring tools (DCIM, Site Scan/Alber, SNMP tools, CCTV systems) to proactively identify and respond to events before service degradation occurs. Govern Data Center physical security standards including badge provisioning, video retention policy, rack access control, and compliance with security audits (SOX, ISO 27001). Lead Rapid Response communication — timely alerts/escalations, bridge coordination, and real-time updates for executives and stakeholder teams. Ensure audit-readiness through meticulous documentation, evidence gathering and policy enforcement. Objective: Data Insights, Reporting & Knowledge Management Maintain detailed logs of inspections, maintenance activity, and incidents to support data-driven decision making and shift turnovers. Publish weekly/monthly ops dashboards covering health, performance, recurring patterns, capacity, energy usage, and vendor SLA compliance. Manage continuous improvement of documentation including runbooks, equipment inventories, configuration diagrams, DR plans, and escalation workflows. Additional Leadership & Innovation Responsibilities Drive automation initiatives (scripted monitoring checks, digital logging, dashboarding, alert tuning) to reduce manual intervention. Participate in Data Center Strategy programs — migrations, cloud transitions, hardware tech refreshes, cage expansions, smart access solutions. Conduct BCP/DR failover drills with Infrastructure Teams and ensure recovery objectives are always met. Mentor junior engineers in operations best practices and oversee knowledge transition to new team members. Represent Data Center Operations in global governance forums and leadership reviews. Champion ESG goals: reducing power consumption and improving PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness). Expected Outcomes & Performance Measures 100% uptime of critical infrastructure supporting high-availability business services. Reduction in environmental incidents through faster mean time to detect (MTTD) & mean time to resolve (MTTR). Demonstrated operational maturity through automation, compliance, and cost efficiency improvements. Strong customer satisfaction from business units due to transparency and proactive communication. Qualifications Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent. Minimum 5 years of experience in a Data Center Operations role. Ability to work in shifts is important as this role will be part of a 24/7 team operating out of India. Familiarity with concepts of power, HVAC, and fire suppression systems within a datacenter environment. Existing experience with Site Scan, Alber, Lenel, Control-M, and Service Now are all valuable, but not required. Basic problem solving and analysis skills. Effective communication and coordination skills. Strong organizational skills.

As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. Drives excellence through ownership and development of digital center of excellence initiatives, contributing to best practice, innovation and continuous improvement across Mace. You’ll Be Responsible For Direct ICT governance, technical assurance, and design compliance across venues and infrastructure projects. Manage consultants, contractors, and vendors to deliver integrated, high-quality digital solutions. Oversee ICT implementation, testing, commissioning, and systems integration to ensure operational readiness. Drive successful handover and sustainable delivery, supporting Mace’s net zero carbon ambitions. Manage the delivery of digital strategies and solutions across projects and programmes, ensuring client-focused outcomes. Provide technical leadership, governance, and oversight across multiple digital disciplines and project stages. Build, manage, and develop high-performing teams, fostering capability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Manage digital budgets, delivery performance, and centre of excellence contributions, supporting Mace’s net zero ambitions. You’ll Need To Have Relevant degree in electrical engineering, IT, computer science, or a related discipline. Industry certifications (e.g., Cisco, Microsoft, BICSI); chartership desirable. review_candidates.title: Beeldtechnicus
review_candidates.description: Bij NEP zoeken we beeldtechnici: ervaren én junior talent is van harte welkom! Wat ga je doen als Beeldtechnicus? Als Beeldtechnicus bij NEP breng je je ervaring in beeldtechniek naar een hoger niveau. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we het perfecte plaatje op zowel televisie als op streaming platforms zoals Viaplay kunnen uitzenden. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de beeldtechniek bij de opnames van televisieprogramma’s sportuitzendingen. Je bewaakt de beeldkwaliteit en zorgt dat alles er piekfijn uitziet, van het instellen van de kleurtemperatuur tot het regelen van het diafragma. Met jouw expertise worden alle beelden binnen no-time omgetoverd tot een perfect geheel. Daarnaast ben je tijdens repetities en opnames verantwoordelijk voor het klaarzetten van de opname- en ondersteunende apparatuur. Je zorgt voor het aansluiten en inregelen van de regiewagen, camera’s, EVS, monitoren en de routing van alle videosignalen. Je biedt technische support en helpt mee bij het oplossen van storingen. Tijdens opnames of live-uitzendingen verzorg je de shading van camera’s zodat het beeld van het scherm afspat. Je werkt zowel vanuit onze centralized production in Hilversum als op verschillende locaties in binnen- en buitenland. Hier Herken Jij Jezelf In Je hebt al ervaring in beeldtechniek en bent klaar voor de volgende stap OF je bent recent afgestudeerd en zoekt een startersbaan als Beeldtechnicus. Je hebt een sterke kennis van AV-techniek en IT, met een passie voor beeldtechniek. Je bent altijd op zoek naar nieuwe dingen om te leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je bent kritisch op je eigen werk en streeft naar constante verbetering, zowel individueel als met je team. Flexibele werktijden zijn voor jou geen probleem; je bent beschikbaar in avonden en weekenden. Je beschikt over goede Nederlandse communicatievaardigheden en kunt effectief werken in een dynamische omgeving. Je woont in Nederland en hebt een rijbewijs B. Dit Zoek Jij In Je Nieuwe Baan Een uitdagende en veelzijdige functie in een internationale broadcast omgeving; Ruimte voor eigen inbreng en persoonlijke ontwikkeling; Een inspirerende werkomgeving waar geen dag hetzelfde is omdat je (in) direct bijdraagt aan toffe producties op locaties waar anderen niet zo snel komen. Events waar iedereen samenkomt zoals een zomerbarbecue, maandelijkse themaborrels, een Family & Friends Day, Sinterklaasfeest, Eindejaarsfeest en sportieve activiteiten zoals een Media Voetbal Toernooi en Mudmasters! Verder Bieden Wij Jou Eencontract voor 32-40 uur per week; Salaris passend bij je functie en ervaring; 25 vakantiedagen op basis van fulltime; Kilometervergoeding of een NS trajectkaart; Pensioenregeling met gedeelde bijdrage; Wij betalen 300 euro per kalenderjaar mee aan jouw sportschool en hebben een aantrekkelijk fietsplan. NEP The Netherlands - We bring content to live! Bij NEP Nederland staan we achter de schermen van de grootste live events en tv-producties. Met innovatieve en creatieve oplossingen verzorgen we het volledige proces: van opname tot wereldwijde distributie. Je kent ons werk van producties als Eredivisie, Formule 1, Vandaag Inside, Lowlands, The Floor, Eva en Lubach . Jij & ons team Bij NEP draait alles om mensen met een passie voor media. Ons team bestaat uit gedreven en creatieve professionals die werken aan sport, muziek, entertainment en live tv. Je krijgt bij ons volop ruimte om te groeien, te leren en te werken met de nieuwste technieken. Of je nu energie krijgt van Formule 1, festivals of live talkshows: bij NEP werk je midden in de mediawereld en breng je content écht tot leven . Als wereldwijd opererende organisatie zijn we in de kern een mensenbedrijf. We bouwen aan een diverse en inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen zichzelf kan zijn en met respect wordt behandeld. Diversiteit en inclusie zijn voor ons geen bijzaak, maar de basis voor innovatie en succes.

review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering
review_candidates.description: About Prove As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn. Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together. Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team! Title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering Department: Engineering Reports To: VP, Platform Engineering FLSA Status: Exempt Location: Ireland Remote Job Summary We are seeking a Senior Manager of Platform Engineering to lead two critical teams based in Ireland: Platform Developer Enablement and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of our cloud infrastructure, driving our transition toward greater platform maturity. You will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and day-to-day execution, ensuring our systems are scalable, reliable, and developer-friendly. Having standardized our technology stack, we are now entering a new phase of maturity focused on developer self-service, extreme reliability, and advanced observability. Key Focus Areas Unified Platform Strategy: Lead the strategic evolution of both the Platform Engineering and SRE teams to foster a culture of shared ownership and operational excellence. Internal Developer Platform (IDP): Drive the development of internal platform services that allow product teams to self-service infrastructure needs, reducing friction and increasing velocity. Reliability & SRE: Lead the team to achieve an internal SLO of 99.999% while establishing clear incident management processes and training Incident Commanders. Process & Standardization: Create clear, repeatable operational processes and documentation that ensure clarity and efficiency across the team and stakeholders. Observability 2.0: Implement a company-wide standard for observability based on OpenTelemetry instrumentation. Responsibilities Leadership & Strategy Lead, inspire, and manage two teams (Platform Developer Enablement & SRE), fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Set clear goals, hire and develop top talent, and mentor engineering managers to build a high-performing organization. Define the platform roadmap, aligning technical investments with business objectives and the broader technology strategy. Champion DevOps principles, automation, and infrastructure-as-code best practices across the organization. Platform Development & Operations Oversee the design and operation of the platform to meet the needs of product teams and internal stakeholders. Drive architectural evolution to ensure the platform remains scalable, resilient, and secure. Establish and maintain rigorous SLOs, ensuring system performance aligns with business requirements. Implement advanced observability, monitoring, and logging frameworks to proactively address potential issues. Collaboration & Communication Partner with product management, security, and other engineering leaders to translate business needs into scalable platform capabilities. Act as a key stakeholder in cross-functional planning, communicating technical risks and architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical leadership. Ensure the platform team acts as an enabler for product teams, promoting design patterns that balance velocity, reliability and security from the start. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of senior-level experience as a Software Engineer, SRE, and/or Platform Engineer. 5+ years of management experience, with proven success leading and coaching other managers. Deep experience running SaaS products in cloud environments (AWS preferred). Strong technical background with Kubernetes, Terraform, and modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitOps, ArgoCD). Programming skills (Go, Java, or similar) to provide technical guidance and conduct code reviews. Expertise in distributed systems design and architecture patterns. Advanced knowledge of observability practices, specifically OpenTelemetry. Familiarity with database technologies (MySQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB) and data streaming/processing (Kafka, Redis). Excellent communication skills, capable of bridging the gap between technical execution and business strategy. This position description should not be considered the final description of the position. The position description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the positions. It should be assumed that we would, to some extent, structure responsibilities in accordance with the successful candidate’s capabilities and changing business conditions. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor. The anticipated salary range for this role is EUR 120,000 - $140,000 plus variable commission / company bonus. Offered salary will be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, geo-location and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Prove follows a market driven compensation philosophy based on geographic location and respective market rates. Job offers will be aligned to location. Please speak with your recruiter if you have questions. Prove defines: Metro 2 - NYC metro area, Seattle metro area, Los Angeles metro area, and the Miami metro area. Metro 3 - all other cities across the domestic United States, with the exception of the San Francisco Bay Area. Benefits & Perks For FTE Provers Competitive salaries & Bonus Plan (for eligible roles) and Equity Plan Modern Health for financial, mental, and physical wellness 401(k) Retirement Plan & Match (US Offices) and Local Country Pension (International Offices) Unlimited Vacation and Flexible hours Comprehensive medical benefits for you and your family ❤️ Emotional & Physical Wellness – Access to wellness services (EAP & Prove Well-Being Reimbursement) Bottomless snacks & beverages for certain office locations Daily GrubHub stipend for lunch if coming into the office (US Offices) A great place to work and connect with other talented Provers like yourself! At Eurofins, you’ll have the opportunity to make a direct impact by ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient IT services across multiple locations. As an IT Field Service Engineer, you provide hands-on technical support to business users on-site, promote Eurofins IT best practices, and collaborate with IT teams on daily operations and projects. You work closely with Infrastructure teams and report into the IT organization, contributing to a stable and compliant IT environment. In this role, you support users with hardware and software issues, ensuring fast and effective resolutions. The organization is committed to continuous improvement of its products and welcomes feedback to enhance learning outcomes and user experience. Role Description The Senior DevOps Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and highly available infrastructure for El Moasser Books’ digital platforms. This role involves building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, automating deployment and monitoring processes, and collaborating closely with development teams to ensure smooth application delivery and performance. The Senior DevOps Engineer will manage cloud and on-premises environments, troubleshoot production issues, and implement best practices for security, reliability, and cost efficiency. Day-to-day tasks include infrastructure-as-code development, environment configuration, performance tuning, and documentation to support ongoing improvements to the company’s educational website and mobile application. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipeline design, automation, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools). Candidates should possess excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional development and product teams.
